meta.note: Prompts describe user experience, not components. expectedComponents are the correct real Baklava bl-* tags.

prompts.prompt: Build a login page. There should be a field for the email address, a field for the password that hides what is typed, and a prominent button at the end to submit the whole thing when the user presses Enter.
Build a settings screen with a list of options the user can turn on and off, plus a dropdown to pick a language and a small hint text explaining each option.

Show a catalog of products in a grid with column headers, rows that have an action button per row, and controls at the bottom to jump between pages of results. Add a small badge on some rows to mark a product as popular.

When the user tries to delete something, show a popup in the middle of the page that blocks the background and asks them to confirm, with a clearly dangerous button to confirm deletion and a safe one to cancel.
After saving, briefly show a small message box in the corner of the screen letting the user know it worked, with a way to dismiss it.
Build an FAQ section where the user clicks a question and it expands to reveal the answer below it. Several questions should be grouped together.
Build a multi-step checkout indicator at the top showing the current step: cart, shipping, then payment. Show a badge over a cart icon to signal the cart has two items.
Build a tabbed interface to switch between different views of the same page, with a couple of tabs and their content panels. Add a tooltip on a small icon button explaining it.
